products.name: Windows Advanced Audit Policy & Security Event Logging Baseline (Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: Configure the full Windows Advanced Audit Policy on Windows 10/11 via Intune Settings Catalog — ~24 CIS/Microsoft-aligned subcategories, command-line process auditing, the force-subcategory override, and a right-sized Security log — pilot-first. Resolves a whole cluster of "Configure Auditing for …" assessment findings. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Turn on the Windows audit trail your investigations actually need

Most Windows fleets are under-audited and don't know it: the default policy captures too little to investigate an incident, it drifts machine to machine, and the modern Advanced Audit Policy subcategories are often silently ignored because one override switch is off. This solution configures the full Windows Advanced Audit Policy Configuration on Windows 10/11 endpoints via Intune Settings Catalog — a consistent, CIS / Microsoft security baseline-aligned audit trail on every device — deployed pilot-first and fully reversible.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — one Settings Catalog profile (Win Audit Policy - Baseline - Pilot) with exact, ordered steps and a recommended Success/Failure value for every subcategory; the object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates, including the mandatory on-device auditpol and Event Viewer checks.

What it fixes (one product, ~24 findings)

This baseline resolves the cluster of "Configure Auditing for …" and "Audit Logon" findings a typical Windows client security assessment raises — Account Logon, Account/Group Management, Logon/Logoff, Object Access (File Share, Removable Storage), Detailed Tracking (Process Creation with command line), Privilege Use, Policy Change, and System — plus the two things teams routinely miss: the force-subcategory override (SCENoApplyLegacyAuditPolicy) and a right-sized Security event log.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how advanced (subcategory) auditing works, the override that makes it apply, what the baseline audits and why, and the event-volume trade-offs (Process Creation and File Share are loud).
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (enrollment, supported build, no conflicting legacy audit policy, log sizing, a pilot group) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to build the named Settings Catalog profile: the override, all ~24 subcategories at recommended CIS/Microsoft values, command-line process auditing, and the Security-log size; then pilot, validate, and expand (including a server variant).
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — readiness discovery, per-device applied-state validation, an audit-coverage report, safe scaffolding of the full profile, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (override active, subcategories set, 4688 command line present, log sized) plus Best Practices for detection-over-volume tuning and workstation vs server split.

Not log forwarding — and that's on purpose

This baseline makes each endpoint generate and retain the right events. Getting those logs into a SIEM (Azure Monitor Agent + Data Collection Rules to Microsoft Sentinel) is a separate solution — this one is the source, that one is the transport. It is also distinct from a broad CIS/STIG hardening baseline: this is the focused auditing slice.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A consistent, baseline-aligned Windows audit trail — with command-line process auditing and a right-sized log — on every corporate endpoint, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WINAUDIT-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for the Windows Advanced Audit Policy baseline
    • WINAUDIT-Remediation.ps1 — safely scaffold and assign the full Settings Catalog audit profile
    • WINAUDIT-Report.ps1 — audit-baseline coverage report for Windows devices (applied or not)
    • WINAUDIT-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — set the target group for the audit baseline profile
    • WINAUDIT-Validation.ps1 — validate assignment and per-device applied state of the audit baseline

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
